verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents a raw HTTP API and SDKs, but the evidence pack contains no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found all common OpenAPI and Swagger paths returning 404. The llms.txt and markdown docs are machine-readable documentation, not an API specification, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
